services.name: Mat Pilates
services.desc: Whether you're just starting a fitness routine or are a seasoned athlete, pilates is a great modality for any level of fitness experience! Pilates focuses on building core strength and stability, learning proper alignment, and improving flexibility through low-impact movements - it truly is for every body. Our Pilates classes follow the principles developed by Joseph Pilates in the early 1900's, and some instructors will put a more contemporary spin on sequencing, and most classes will have music playing in the background.
